historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent completed qualifying regular-season games before the historical cutoff.

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 8

sportsbook_alternates.snapshot_note: Retrieved once for Stage 2; exact FanDuel alternate rows used for the ten locked Stage 1 qualifiers.

core_selection_rule: Choose FanDuel alternate with American odds -350 to -150 inclusive, closest numerically to -250; tie resolves to more negative price.
floor_rule: Immediately lower available alternate threshold than CORE.
ceiling_rule: Immediately higher available alternate threshold than CORE, regardless of HR.
historical_hr_rule: For every alternate Over line, hits = count of locked Stage 1 observations strictly greater than the listed alternate line; exact-line pushes are not hits; denominator remains N=10.
candidate_narrowing_rule: Carry forward if at least one Floor or Core alternate Over HR is >=7/10, aligned to the V7.2.9 minimum 70% historical HR required for final portfolio consideration. Exact-line pushes are not hits; denominator remains 10. No current-week context used for exclusion.
player_ordering_rule: QB → RB → WR → TE; within position sort P15 relative to the locked current main-market line: above first (smallest positive difference), equal next, below last (closest below first).

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent completed qualifying regular-season games before the historical cutoff.

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 8

role_basis.QB: Named starters: Josh Allen and Carson Wentz
role_basis.RB: Primary/secondary backs with meaningful expected usage: James Cook, Ty Johnson, Jordan Mason and Aaron Jones
role_basis.WR: Three expected WR roles: Bills DJ Moore, Khalil Shakir, Keon Coleman; Vikings Justin Jefferson, Jordan Addison and Myles Price as next man at WR3 while Jauan Jennings is out
role_basis.TE: Top expected TE: Dalton Kincaid and T.J. Hockenson

exclusions.reason: Ruled out; calf; Myles Price is next at WR3
RB3 with limited expected touch volume; not included as a meaningful secondary back
Depth-chart backup to Justin Jefferson rather than one of the three expected active WR roles

prior_stage1_state.qualification_rule: Current Market HR >= 6/10 OR at least one fixed ladder threshold >= 8/10
